subject: POC preflight: split hands-on option + evening slot availability
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Bryan Lewis <bryan@starlite-ai.com>, Elena Morozova <elena@starlite-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Subject: POC preflight: split hands-on option + evening slot availability

Hi Bryan / Elena,

Thanks again for setting up the POC with us — I wanted to share a short preflight checklist (attached) and a couple of session-layout options so we can lock a time that works across your team. We had a scheduled kickoff earlier this week that I believe didn’t connect, so below are proposals to get us back on track.

Attachments: redwood-preflight-checklist.pdf (PDF, 38KB), runbook-v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

Quick asks before we confirm:
- Confirm list of attendees for the hands-on (names + roles).
- Tell us whether you prefer a single continuous workshop or split sessions (prompt review first, load test after).
- Let us know any IP whitelisting or VPN/KMS constraints so engineering can provision.

Option A — Single session (recommended if stakeholders are colocated):
- 90 minutes: Wed Jul 21, 10:00 PDT / 13:00 EDT / 19:00 CEST
- Topics: prompt walkthrough + routing choices + 20-min load test (low intensity)

Option B — Split (recommended for mixed timezones or heavy load test):
- Prompt review (live): Wed Jul 21, 19:00 PDT / Thu Jul 22, 04:00 CEST — 45 minutes
- Dedicated load test: Thu Jul 22, 23:30 PDT / Fri Jul 23, 08:30 CEST — 60+ minutes (post-business hours)

If neither works, please suggest two windows (one evening / one morning) and we’ll coordinate. If you want us to provision a test account and sample load generator IPs ahead of time, we can do that — we’ll share creds via our secure vault and rotate them after the test.

I’ve cc’d Marissa for commercial items and Vivek from engineering to help with the load test plan. Happy to hold a 30-min dry run 30–60 minutes before the hands-on if you want to test connectivity.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Subject: Re: POC preflight: split hands-on option + evening slot availability

Hi Lauren,

Apologies — I was traveling earlier this week and missed the kickoff. Thanks for following up + for the checklist.

We’re leaning towards the split approach. The engineering team wants to do the prompt/review part during our overlap window and run the heavier load test outside our peak hours so it doesn't affect our staging clusters. Two quick asks from our side:
- Can you provide a temporary read-only test IAM user and token so we can control access?
- We’ll need a list of load generator IPs so our infra team can whitelist before the test.

Proposed windows that work for us:
- Prompt review: Wed Jul 21, 19:00 PDT (works for our US team)
- Load test: Thu Jul 22, 00:30 PDT (late night, our infra team can be on call)

Would prefer a 30-min dry run ~30 minutes before the prompt review. If you can confirm those times, I’ll get Oliver and a couple of engineers on the invites.

— Bryan

- Prompt review (hands-on): Wed Jul 21, 19:00 PDT — 60 minutes
- Load test (separate invite): Thu Jul 22, 00:30 PDT — 90 minutes (we’ll keep it flexible, can trim to 60)

Action items (Redwood):

- Attach test data (small sample) to the invites: testdata-small.csv
